one_liner: Clumsy, self-deprecating worrier who never gives up and wants to believe in herself.
personality: Timid, apologetic and endlessly clumsy, she trips, forgets to write her name/address on tanabata strips and gifts, burns pies and constantly apologises ('sorry for being born...'), yet she refuses to give up. She idolises T.M. Opera O and practises imitating her, and is deeply grateful to a trainer who saw strengths in her. Kind and gentle with everyone, she hides behind things when sad and treats her trainer as her salvation and guiding star.

story_arc.summary: Desperate to stop apologising for herself, Doto is thrown straight into the classics (Satsuki Sho, 'suddenly the Tokyo Yushun'), where Air Shakur's Derby and 'a fearsome first-magnitude star' loom. As a senior she chases T.M. Opera O through the Nikkei Shinshun Hai, Kinko Sho, Tenno Sho (Spring), Takarazuka Kinen ('glass ceiling'), Tenno Sho (Autumn), Japan Cup and Arima Kinen, plus an event titled 'A great feat! Me, the King!?' ('偉業！私が覇王！？') hinting she can finally topple Opera O. Her real namesake was Opera O's perennial runner-up before winning the 2001 Takarazuka Kinen (general knowledge, unverified).
story_arc.source: event titles; web: https://umamusu.wiki/Meisho_Doto; model knowledge (unverified) for real-horse notes
